plans.idea: Classic two-column square: a tall bottle column on the left faces a right-aligned stack of headline, subcopy, the two badges and the CTA sharing one left edge, with the legal line as a full-width footer.

Headline-first: a full-width headline and subcopy band across the top, then a lower row with a square bottle on the left and the badges stacked over a large CTA on the right, so the eye reads message, then product, then action, with legal at the foot.

Product-led top band: the bottle sits top-left with the two badges grouped beside it as its claims, a full-width headline and subcopy block below, and a footer row pairing the CTA (left, on the text's edge) with the small legal copy (right).
